page.layout: One page of running text, one column, full width. No margin notes. Running head at top centre-left, page number at top right. Signature "M 4" at the foot, right of centre.

main_text.l: vitijs nos dehortantur, ac simul indicant da-
mna quæ oriuntur ex illis.
Auferunt autem Venus & vinum .i. abu-
sus vini, homini cor, hoc eit, fortitudinem fi-
dei, vel intellectum seu mentem, ac ipsam fe-
dem sapientiæ, & præstantissimam hominis
partem, ex qua rationis vsus, vita & salus u-
niuersa dependet, & qua sola à brutis differi
mus. Qui enim occupatur & iugiter versa-
tur in fornicationibus & ebrietatibus, ille o-
nem amittit intellectum, ut fine ullo timore
Dei ambulet, & facile ab eius cultu recedat:
id quod Israelitis contigisse multi scribūt pro-
phetæ: quippe qui carnalibus illis vitijs immer-
si, gloriâ Dei cōmutarunt in gloriam ligni .i.
idoli. Fornicationem igitur carnis (propter
quā vitandam suā quisq; vxorem habeat, &
suū quæq; viru, 1.Cor.7.[?]) sequitur fornicatio
mentis, Num.25. ȝ[?], Reg.11. & hanc perditio,
Psal.73. Unde Salom.Prou.6. inquit: Qui a-
dulterium committit cum muliere, is deficit
corde: & qui vult perdere animam suā, agit
in hunc modum. & Prou.23. Si quidem fouea
profunda est meretrix, & puteus angustus a-
lie-na (i.vt ex profunda fouea nemo facile a-
scendere potest, ita citra difficultate nullus li-
berari poterit, quæ scortorum nexus semel liga-
uerint) Ipsa enim in modum raptoris infi-
dias struit, & adijcit (sibi) homines facinoro-
sos: vel, conficit homines perfides: vel,
homines prævaricatores, ut quidam inter-
pretantur. Vetus interpres vertit incautos.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "183" page number (the final digit is printed as a yogh-like form, read as 3). "Num.25. ȝ" (the reference number is unclear, may be 1 or 3). "viru, 1.Cor.7." (the numeral before Cor. is unclear, read as 1). "Prou.23." is printed as "Prou.2ȝ" in the scan, read here as 23. Printed "cömutarunt" and "cōtigisse" use the umlaut/macron as printed. Printed "mslti" read as "multi". Printed "augustus" in the scan appears as "anguftus", read as "angustus". Printed hyphens kept at line ends: "da-mna", "o-nem", "a-dulterium", "alie-na", "a-scendere", "li-berari", "liga-uerint", "infi-dias", "facinoro-sos", "u-niuersa", "abu-sus", "fi-dei", "fe-dem", "versa-tur", "v-"). The word "vniuersa" is printed "viniuersa" in the scan and is read as "u-niuersa".
